Part of the METTLER TOLEDO Thermal Analysis Excellence line, the DSC 3 has a modular design that makes it ideal for automatic or manual operation, right from production and quality assurance through to research and development.
Differential Scanning Calorimetry for Routine Analysis
The DSC makes use of a versatile and strong DSC sensor with 56 thermocouples, which ensures excellent sensitivity and resolution.
Robust endurance-tested sample robot—works reliably and efficiently day and night
Robust MultiSTARe sensor with 56 thermocouples—identifies the smallest and largest thermal effects
One Click™—enables the user to initiate predefined techniques easily and securely
